description: On the bed in front of you are two white plastic pieces—a base and a round-topped post—set on a green sheet with a dark blue pillow behind them. The left hand slides in from the left to steady the base while the right hand reaches in from the right, lifts the round-topped post as a right-hand object, aligns it over the base, and presses it down to attach; then the right hand lets go and both hands withdraw, leaving the assembled piece standing upright.
